mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because it brought the chapter's pieces together and showed how oxygen reaches tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add the lining to the open lung spaces was confusing: the result gave no indication that the lining first needed to join the capillary mesh.

surprise.text: The comparison showing that smaller sacs offer more surface area for the same air volume was interesting and helped explain their shape.

arbitrary.text: The required order for constructing the exchange surface felt somewhat arbitrary from the item descriptions, although the finished construction showed why the parts belong together.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the constructions and explanations made me curious about how other body systems support the working cells. The picture descriptions were useful, though I cannot judge whether finished illustrations would be as clear.
